map.ASET 为危险临界状态到来前可用的时间，由烟气沉降、温度、毒性等决定。: ASET is the time available before a dangerous critical state arrives, determined by smoke descent, temperature and toxicity.
map.RSET 由探测报警、疏散前行为（识别反应）与行走时间三部分组成。: RSET consists of three parts: detection/alarm, pre-movement behavior (recognition and reaction) and travel time.

map.ASET 和 RSET 哪个更重要？: Which of ASET and RSET is more important?
map.两者缺一不可，关键是 ASET > RSET 且留足裕度；工程可接受准则通常要求: Neither can be dispensed with; the key is ASET > RSET with an adequate margin; the engineering acceptability criterion usually requires ASET/RSET ≥ 1.5 (some codes take 1.2-1.3), and the larger the safer.
map.RSET 的组成里哪段最易压缩？: Which part of RSET is easiest to shorten?
map.行走时间取决于距离与出口宽度，预动作时间取决于报警与人员状态；优化疏散指示、减少: Travel time depends on distance and exit width, and pre-movement time depends on the alarm and occupants' state; optimizing evacuation signage, reducing pre-movement delay and widening exits most effectively reduce RSET.
